body:
Integration-owner check for w-3fe8 (Termal::Opus2). Compacted at revision 11; full history is in revisions 1 to 10.

RULES
- Greg's order: turn gating is PHYSICALLY DELETED with ZERO LEGACY: no compatibility code, executable legacy route, fallback to evaluate, begin, grant or settlement, or setting that can reactivate gating.
- The acceptance EVALUATOR stays in code and docs, temporarily OFF and non-blocking (Fable2 #3821). Do not require its deletion.
- Before landing, the item must carry a cited source search showing no turn-operation or routing_token senders.
- Opus3's w-2aa5 docs must match the final input.
- Cutover: TermAl w-3fe8 is installed and running first, then Engram's deletion and store migration in the same coordinated restart.
- The landing FULL is `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit` on the clean exact candidate.
- AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md change, so the authority conditions apply: (a) both coordinators' concurrence quotes the exact wording on w-3ed252d21d84; (b) Greg's notice is recorded (Fable2 #1812); (c) the final-diff audit is PASSED and names the gated input fingerprint. Check 4 hunks per file and no widening of authority. The audit script PASSED for ec8e8262 and Fable2 countersigned it. C3's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are byte-identical to it, so restate the audit with the gated candidate's FULL fingerprint.

HISTORY
- C2 ec8e8262, round 1: Codex failed on coverage; Claude found 2 MEDIUM (w-3ab66c26d9e3, w-660a1be53ca4), since fixed.
- C3 44d4fc9d (tree 105d3160, parent 5dd913d2), round 2 at 21:21Z with brief .tmp/c3-review-brief.md and shards .tmp/c3-shard-S1..S6.txt:
  - Codex delegation-57d53bb0 FAILED on coverage (not an outage, so no Kimi). Only S3 was complete.
  - Claude delegation-d0d9aa64 COMPLETED with Lows only. It confirms M1, M2 and the zero-legacy protocol.
  - Filed w-3833fefc0b4f (P2: Disable resets executionObservability; new field; verified by me) and w-90de8de3e8d6 (P3 docs). Noted w-a8616540d235.
  - The protocol Note is resolved: Engram 5e8f28dd domain ObservedOccurrence matches TermAl.
- Landing FULL test-189c7403 on C3, run by Sol-03d4, notifies Fable2.
- Known follow-ups (dedupe them): w-c20aee27bd34, w-c3f8e794a22d, w-527705d12568, w-fa69ae148eee, w-647cd063fdad, w-a8616540d235, w-d4ad976f2cd3.

NOW (about 21:40Z)
Sent Fable2 #3910: NO LANDING. Recommendation:
- C4 = C3 + the w-3833 fix (optionally the w-90de docs).
- Round 3 with an explicit accepted-coverage contract: added lines + hunk context per file, deletions by named symbol search, docs by stale-term search + changed hunks.
- A new landing FULL for C4; 189c becomes evidence only.
- Alternatively: keep C3 and re-run only Codex.
Splitting Codex across several children in one round is outside /review-changes and needs Greg's word. Waiting for Fable2.
On landing: regenerate the landing script from .tmp/landing-msgs/land-8ec0.sh for the gated candidate. Review checkout: .tmp/wt-review-c3-8111 (replace it if C4).
Cleanup later: .tmp/wt-ba8d-full*-8111, the .evidence directories when their items close, and .tmp/engram-5e8f28dd-protocol.


ROUND 3 at 22:36Z on C4 0a16caf2c66eab42413c84b119ce5e9c0aeec429 (tree 2ca1b805c8a933a9a1284b524eb76e91b1cf6c47, parent 5dd913d2).
- C4 = C3 + the settings fix e578, docs b1a5, the A fixture ec83 and the B product fix d167. 15 delta paths; same path set as C3. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are byte-identical to C3.
- C3 FULL 189c FAILED 7 tests (A fixture, B product in D1); C3 is dead.
- Pair: Codex delegation-3b8a567c (session-15929) and Claude delegation-6412c1ed (session-15930). Wait delegation-wait-6c2fb3a6.
- Brief .tmp/c4-review-brief.md (sha c8281301); shards .tmp/c4-shard-S*.txt; review checkout .tmp/wt-review-c4-8111.
- C4 landing FULL test-6580d0ce… (Sol-03d4; completion goes to Fable2). The candidate fingerprint is 707d3161…, but the audit restatement needs the FULL run's fingerprint.
- Recorded on w-3fe8 as e364be1e.
- On landing: BASE 5dd913d2, C 0a16caf2…, TREE 2ca1b805….
